The '''Drainage Isle''' was an island located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], near the [[River Lands]] and the [[Old Muckworks]]. A huge putrid [[chemilizard]] lived there during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />
